camel_example: aliyun aideepsign CreateWatermarkSignTask --region cn-hangzhou --FileType video --WatermarkContent 'wm-e2e-85970647' --Level '"2"' --version 2026-05-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits a combined task for invisible watermark embedding and C2PA signing
description_zh: 提交暗水印嵌入+C2PA签名合并任务
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-watermark-sign-task --file-type video --watermark-content wm-e2e-85970647 --level '"2"' --api-version 2026-05-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWatermarkSignTask

parameters.help_en: The file type. Valid values: image, video, and audio. For audio files, watermarks are always processed through the Elastic Algorithm Service (EAS) pipeline with a fixed capacity of 32 bits (auto_len is invalid), and the file extension of the signed output is always .wav
parameters.help_zh: 文件类型，取值：image（图片）、video（视频）、audio（音频）；音频档水印恒走EAS链路、容量恒32bit（auto_len无效），签名产物扩展名恒为.wav
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the file to be processed. Either this parameter or ObjectKey is required. Images, videos, and audio files are supported, and only the HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. The source file extension is validated against the intersection of C2PA signing capabilities and watermark tier capabilities: only .jpg, .jpeg, and .png for images, only .mp4 (up to 10 minutes and 100 MB) for videos, and only .flac, .m4a, .mp3, and .wav for audio files
parameters.help_zh: 待处理文件的URL地址，与ObjectKey二选一必填，支持图片、视频和音频，仅支持http/https协议；源扩展名按C2PA签名能力与水印档位能力交集校验：image仅.jpg/.jpeg/.png，video仅.mp4（10分钟以内、100MB以内），audio仅.flac/.m4a/.mp3/.wav
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The watermark content. The service internally maps this content to an integer watermark ID and restores the original content upon extraction
parameters.help_zh: 水印内容，服务内部映射为整数水印ID，提取时还原返回
parameters.name: watermark_content

parameters.help_en: The watermark embedding strength. Valid values: 0 to 3. Default value: 2. A higher strength indicates better robustness but lower visual quality
parameters.help_zh: 水印嵌入强度，取值0-3，默认2；强度越高鲁棒性越好、视觉质量越差
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The reserved parameter used to pass extended parameters such as subkeys, for example, subkey:xxx. The subkey is used to isolate different customers under the same primary key and cannot contain commas
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，用于传递子key等扩展参数，如subkey:xxx（子key用于同一主key下隔离不同客户，不能包含逗号）
parameters.name: reserved

parameters.help_en: The optional content source type for C2PA tracing. The current version does not support writing to the DigiCert manifest
parameters.help_zh: 可选的内容来源类型，用于C2PA溯源，当前版本暂不支持写入DigiCert Manifest
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The optional name of the software that generated the content for C2PA tracing. The current version does not support writing to the DigiCert manifest
parameters.help_zh: 可选的生成该内容的软件名称，用于C2PA溯源，当前版本暂不支持写入DigiCert Manifest
parameters.name: software_agent

parameters.help_en: The optional custom C2PA assertions provided as a JSON array string. Up to 64 assertions are supported, and each assertion cannot exceed 4,096 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 可选的自定义C2PA断言，JSON数组字符串，最多64条，单条不超过4096字节
parameters.name: custom_assertions

parameters.help_en: The optional name of the user's Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket to which the signing result is written. If this parameter is empty, the result is written to an internal bucket of the service and returned through SignedFileUrl
parameters.help_zh: 可选，签名结果写入的用户OSS Bucket名称；为空时结果写入服务内部Bucket并通过SignedFileUrl返回
parameters.name: target_bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the user's OSS bucket. This parameter is required when TargetBucketName is not empty, for example, cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 用户OSS Bucket所在地域ID，当TargetBucketName非空时必填，如cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: target_bucket_region

parameters.help_en: The optional complete object key for writing the signed output to the user's bucket. This parameter must be provided together with TargetBucketName. It must start with ai-deepsign-signed/ and be a complete object name with a file extension, rather than a directory prefix. The server does not append the _signed suffix or a trailing slash
parameters.help_zh: 可选，签名产物写入用户Bucket的完整Object Key，须与TargetBucketName同时提供；必须以ai-deepsign-signed/开头，且为含扩展名的完整对象名（非目录前缀），服务端不再追加_signed后缀或补尾斜杠
parameters.name: target_object_key

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when the target object already exists. Default value: false. If the target object exists, the creation is rejected. Set this parameter to true to allow overwriting existing objects and support in-place signing, where the target object key can be the same as the source
parameters.help_zh: 可选，目标对象已存在时是否允许覆盖，缺省false即目标已存在则拒绝创建；置true允许覆盖既有对象，支持就地签名（目标Object Key可与源相同）
parameters.name: allow_overwrite

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. If the request is successful, `200` is returned
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The details of the backend exception

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the combined task, which is used for subsequent GetWatermarkSignTaskResult queries
TaskId.description_zh: 合并任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkSignTaskResult查询
TaskId.title_en: 合并任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkSignTaskResult查询
TaskId.title_zh: 合并任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkSignTaskResult查询
